summary: Iteration 28 frontend-only testing of 5 new features (Casanéo, Expo web preview at rental-hub-manager.preview.emergentagent.com). All 5 features validated end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 with QA admin (qa.admin@casaneo.test). Result: 6/6 UI checks PASS. (1) Historique des messages collapsible section (testID=msg-history-toggle) renders under 'Contacter le voyageur', expands to show 'Aucun message envoyé pour cette réservation.' on a reservation without history. (2) Tourist tax auto-recalc bug fix works exactly: with Loù Cabanoù (tourist_tax_pct=5.0 + regional_tax_pct=1.1 → total 6.1%), typing 100 in nights-total sets tourist-tax=6.1, and 200 sets 12.2 (exact). (3) Comptabilité: export-pdf & export-csv buttons visible in Aperçu tab under 'Importer les revenus'; CSV click triggered a real download (journal-2026-08.csv); PDF click did not throw any error/red screen (print dialog blocked in headless as expected). (4) /settings/payments shows payment-reminders-card with reminders-switch, reminders-mode-all/direct chips and reminders-excl-Airbnb chip; mode toggling direct↔all works and card persists after full reload. Final server state verified via GET /api/preferences: {enabled:true, mode:'all', excluded_platforms:['Airbnb'], days:[7,3]} — matches user's desired state. (5) /property-form?id=<Loù Cabanoù> shows testID=prop-gyg field 'Activités (GetYourGuide)' after the Livret d'accueil section; initial value is empty (untouched, per instructions). No modifications were saved on any form. Console warnings noted only (deprecated shadow* / pointerEvents / expo-notifications on web) — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning across many screens: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — Expo/RN moving to unified boxShadow API. Non-blocking but should be migrated to avoid future breakage. Reference: multiple StyleSheets in /app/frontend/app/*.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/*.tsx.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: appears during login (likely in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx or a shared UI component).

action_items: None blocking. Optional cleanup: replace 'shadow*' style props (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius) with the unified 'boxShadow' style prop across the codebase to silence the deprecation warning on RN web/Expo SDK.
Optional cleanup: replace 'pointerEvents' React prop by 'style={{ pointerEvents: ... }}' on the affected component (likely one of the login screen wrappers).
critical_code_review_comments: reservation-form.tsx:207-219 — setNightsTotal correctly recomputes tourist_tax from (tourist_tax_pct + regional_tax_pct) of the selected property. Formula: Math.round(nightsTotal * pct) / 100 (line 76). Verified numerically: 100 × 6.1% = 6.1, 200 × 6.1% = 12.2. If pct is 0 the field is left as user-entered (not cleared) — acceptable behavior since it lets user override manually.
reservation-form.tsx:708-745 — msg-history-toggle uses Pressable + testID and renders 'Aucun message envoyé pour cette réservation.' as empty state. LGTM.
accounting.tsx:327-333 — export-pdf/export-csv buttons correctly disabled while exporting is truthy. Suggest adding aria-busy for a11y but non-blocking.

settings/payments.tsx:137-190 — payment-reminders-card structure is clean; the toggle, mode chips and per-platform excluded chips all wired to a single PUT /api/preferences call. Reload persistence verified.
property-form.tsx:344-348 — prop-gyg field present, keyboardType default (URL/email would be nicer). Trimmed on save (line 175). LGTM.
seed_data_creation: None. No reservation created, no property saved. Property reminders preferences ended in the desired state {enabled:true, mode:'all', excluded_platforms:['Airbnb']} as verified via GET /api/preferences.
